title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression gating and quality thresholds
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: add a GitHub Actions hook that runs the eval-harness prompt regression checks on PRs touching prompts or eval configs to catch regressions early. This implements quality gating so failing prompt-set regressions or quality metric drops block merges unless overridden by an approver.

What this does: installs a lightweight CI job (eval/ci-prompt-gate) that runs the eval-harness subset for changed prompt sets, evaluates configured metrics (exact match, normalized BLEU, semantic-similarity using embedder), and compares against baseline thresholds stored in eval-harness/ci/baselines/*. If any metric drops below the configured threshold or the prompt regression test fails, the job fails and posts a summary comment on the PR with links to the failing prompt cases and suggested next steps.

Design notes: - Thresholds are per-prompt-set and per-model-profile to allow conservative gating for risky models. - Baselines are YAML files in eval-harness/ci/baselines; updates require an approved cherrypick and a matching eval run. - The hook uses cached model artifacts (s3-backed CI cache) to keep runtime under 6m for most PRs.

Checklist: - [x] Add GH Action workflow eval-prompt-gate.yml - [x] Add runner script scripts/ci/prompt_gate.py - [x] Add small smoke test suite tests/ci/test_prompt_gate.py - [x] Add baseline YAML and README - [x] Post PR comment with failure summary on job failure - [x] Tests + docs updated

Usage: changes touching eval configs, prompt-sets, or the /prompts/ directory will trigger the job. Maintainers can bypass using "ci:force" label (audited). For major baseline updates follow ENG-8421 workflow documented in eval-harness/ci/README.md.

Rollback: baseline updates are gated; if a bad baseline lands we will revert and run upstream regression harness and notify impacted repos.

Related: ENG-8421 (quality gating), ENG-8477 (CI coverage improvements), SUP-513 (customer-reported regression that motivated alerting).

Docs: ci/README + how to update baselines
review_comments: Marco Ruiz: Please make the threshold comparison tolerant to sampling noise (use bootstrap CI or require >2% drop and p<0.05). Otherwise we risk flapping on nightly models.
Aisha Patel: Good point — updated prompt_gate to compute bootstrap CIs and require either an absolute drop > 0.02 or p < 0.05 depending on sample size. Added note in README.
Marco Ruiz: Thanks — can you also add a short-circuit for datasets under 50 examples? Those should surface a non-blocking warning instead of a hard fail.
Aisha Patel: Implemented short-circuit; now small sets produce a WARN comment and do not block merge unless the label ci:force is absent and a reviewer marks it as must-fail.
Leah Chen: CI is green for me locally and the Action logs are readable. Approving pending one clean rerun on GH Actions.
Omar Sato: Quick nits in the docs corrected in a follow-up commit. Approving.
Leah Chen: Re-run of flaky integration on GH Actions passed — approving and marking ready to merge.
Repo automation: eval-prompt-gate job posted a comment with failing cases when baseline mismatches were detected (see sample in Action logs).
